items.title: Star subs rescue Chelsea as Alonso 'takes blame'
items.description: Chelsea get the better of Leeds in a cup thriller, but Blues boss Xabi Alonso has food for thought after needing rescue act from his star substitutes.

items.title: Liverpool will reward Mac Allister if he lets his football do talking
items.description: After saying he was "very sad" at the lack of a contract offer from Liverpool, Alexis Mac Allister proved his worth against Atletico Madrid.

items.title: Arteta explains new role for transformed Odegaard
items.description: Martin Odegaard is a player transformed at the start of this season - and Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta puts his captain's impressive form down to fitness and new positioning.

items.title: Prince William launches sport mental health toolkit
items.description: Prince William urges sport at every level to make suicide prevention part of its culture through a new nationwide toolkit called On Your Side.

items.title: Papers: Liverpool eye January swoop for Chelsea and Man Utd midfield target
items.description: The top stories and transfer rumours from Thursday's newspapers...

items.title: Odegaard is an 'artist for this whole side' - Onuoha
items.description: Match of the Day pundits Nedum Onuoha and Rory Smith discuss Martin Odegaard's performance in Arsenal's Champions League match against Napoli as well as his prospects for the season.

items.title: Arsenal are passing every test - and Odegaard is in form of his life
items.description: Another Arsenal win, another Martin Odegaard goal - the Gunners captain looks back to his best, writes Phil McNulty.

items.title: Newcastle still open to Hall sale - Thursday's gossip
items.description: Lewis Hall could still leave Newcastle despite new contract, Yasin Ayari close to committing to Brighton but Kaoru Mitoma set for exit, and Chelsea to go back for Manu Kone in midfielder search.

items.title: How Mac Allister 'let his feet do the talking' - Warnock
items.description: Match of the Day pundit Stephen Warnock praises an "exceptional" Alexis Mac Allister as the Argentinian midfielder scores a brilliant winner in Liverpool's 2-1 Champions League win over Atletico Madrid at Anfield.

items.title: Odegaard gives dominant Arsenal win over Napoli
items.description: Martin Odegaard's superb strike gave Arsenal a deserved 1-0 victory over Napoli in their Champions League opener.

items.title: Chelsea hit SIX second-half goals to see off Leeds in Carabao Cup classic
items.description: An incredible second-half comeback including six goals in 41 minutes saw Chelsea finally blow away Leeds 6-3 in one of the all-time Carabao Cup classics at Stamford Bridge.
